verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes a documented public Data Access API with an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec on SwaggerHub. The SmartBear developer portal adds per-operation reference pages and dedicated Authentication, Pagination, Rate Limiting and Versioning docs, which is a well-documented programmatic surface. The 404 probes only show the spec isn't hosted at docs.bugsnag.com paths, and do not contradict the SwaggerHub spec. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the API supports write/control actions (e.g., changing error status or assignment) rather than only data access, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API.
